correctness.guest_run_blocker: display.driver exited before compositor and shell startup

retained_ranges: the bootloader memory descriptor containing the active BSP stack
notes: BootInfo, the transformed memory map, and the SMP handoff are copied into kernel-owned storage before reclamation.
An empty or oversized memory map, an invalid kernel range, inconsistent SMP handoff metadata, and a stack in Usable memory reject reclamation.
On validation or transformation failure, the kernel keeps the original memory map and reports that reclamation was skipped.
The BSP boot stack remains reserved until a later change switches it to a kernel-owned stack.
